hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Maintain a contiguous range of indices where every character appears at most twice.

hints.title: Window Invariant
hints.text: Expand the right boundary character by character and track counts. If any character exceeds frequency two, contract from the left.

hints.title: Boundary Update
hints.text: Increment the count of the incoming character. While count exceeds two, decrement count of the character at the left pointer and advance left.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each character is visited at most twice by the two pointers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings takes O(n^2) or O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using a fixed 26-element array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the sliding window pattern and maintain the frequency invariant.
